title: Crew Access Note: Stairs on Member Freight Pickups (Northgate Purchases & Returns)
content:
For the member pickup fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on the changed-mind freight pickup of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership, the stair work is priced from the delivery that brought the merchandise in.

## Stairs on the member pickup

When the delivery appointment that delivered the purchase charged two or more flights of stairs, 20.00 is added; when it charged exactly one flight, 10.00 is added; otherwise nothing is added.

The flights are the stair-carry flights charged on the Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment that delivered the purchase — the units of its stair-carry service charges, added together. The amount is added to the member pickup fee.

| Stair-carry flights charged on the delivering appointment | Added to the member pickup fee |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 20.00 |
| exactly 1 | 10.00 |
| none, or no Northgate delivery appointment | nothing |

Hypothetical readings: a delivery that charged 3 flights adds 20.00; one that charged a single flight adds 10.00; a curbside drop with no stair-carry charge adds nothing.
